```python
import os

from cyhole.helius import Helius


def get_das_asset(asset_id: str):
    helius = Helius(api_key=os.environ["HELIUS_API_KEY"])
    return helius.client.das.get_asset(id=asset_id)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asset_id = "F9Lw3ki3hJ7PF9HQXsBzoY8GyE6sPwLcnUq9AkbFYewT"
    asset = get_das_asset(asset_id)
    print(asset.model_dump_json(indent=2))
```
